name: Membrane helix prediction benchmark (benchmark server)
description: A benchmarking server and dataset using high-resolution protein structures to assess the accuracy of membrane helix prediction methods.
evaluation_method: per-residue accuracy and MCC (Matthews correlation coefficient)
reputation: Well-established community benchmarking server used by protein prediction groups for evaluating membrane helix predictors.
notes: Non-LLM, structure-derived benchmark; potential dataset bias toward proteins with solved high-resolution structures; metrics can vary by dataset curation and transmembrane topology definitions.
